title: MeasurementRepository
responsibility: Stores and reads kernel benchmark runs, one file per machine profile.

inputs.name: MeasurementRepository.constructor.root
inputs.description: Root directory used to resolve explicit file paths and build profile paths beneath the measurements directory. The constructor stores this string without checking or creating the directory.

inputs.name: MeasurementRepository.write.benchmark
inputs.description: Kernel benchmark value serialized with stableJson. Its profile.id selects the default profile filename when no explicit file is provided, and write does not schema-validate the value.

provenance.note: Observational measurements from a local benchmark run. They are not verification evidence and cannot establish or satisfy a budget baseline.

inputs.name: MeasurementRepository.write.file
inputs.description: Optional output path passed with the repository root to resolve. If omitted or empty, the destination is derived from benchmark.profile.id; parent directories are created recursively.

inputs.name: MeasurementRepository.read.file
inputs.description: Filename resolved against the repository root before reading. The resulting file must exist and contain JSON accepted by kernelBenchmarkSchema, or read fails.

inputs.name: MeasurementRepository.forProfile.profile
inputs.description: Profile string interpolated into this repository's default filename and, when available, the shipped measurements filename. It is not validated or sanitized before path construction.

outputs.name: MeasurementRepository.write
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the path written: a truthy explicit file resolved against the root, or otherwise the profile path derived from benchmark.profile.id. It rejects if directory creation or file writing fails.

outputs.name: MeasurementRepository.read
outputs.description: Schema-validated KernelBenchmark parsed from the resolved file. Missing files and schema-invalid parsed values go through fail; invalid JSON throws during JSON.parse.

provenance.note: Observational measurements from a local benchmark run. They are not verification evidence and cannot establish or satisfy a budget baseline.

outputs.name: MeasurementRepository.forProfile
outputs.description: Schema-validated benchmark from the first existing candidate, checking the repository profile file before the shipped measurement file. It returns undefined only when neither candidate exists; malformed selected files fail through read.

provenance.note: Observational measurements from a local benchmark run. They are not verification evidence and cannot establish or satisfy a budget baseline.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: read uses fail when the file is absent or when parsed JSON fails kernelBenchmarkSchema validation. forProfile propagates this when its first existing candidate is invalid.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: JSON.parse throws SyntaxError when file contents are not valid JSON. read does not catch it, and forProfile propagates it through read.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Node filesystem operations can throw or reject with Error when creating the destination directory or reading or writing a file fails.
